arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta

uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@calendar-assistant"
dtstamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

ics = f"""BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Calendar Assistant//Team Meeting//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:PUBLISH
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:{uid}
DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}
DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Shanghai:20260805T150000
DTEND;TZID=Asia/Shanghai:20260805T160000
SUMMARY:Team Meeting
DESCRIPTION:Weekly team sync.\\n\\nLocation metadata unavailable at creation time.
STATUS:CONFIRMED
SEQUENCE:0
BEGIN:VALARM
ACTION:DISPLAY
DESCRIPTION:Team Meeting starts in 15 minutes
TRIGGER:-PT15M
END:VALARM
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
"""

with open("team_meeting_2026-08-05.ics", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(ics)
print("Written team_meeting_2026-08-05.ics")
print("UID:", uid)
EOF

python3 - <<'EOF'
try:
    from icalendar import Calendar
    with open("team_meeting_2026-08-05.ics", "rb") as f:
        cal = Calendar.from_ical(f.read())
    for c in cal.walk():
        if c.name == "VEVENT":
            print("SUMMARY:", c.get("summary"))
            print("DTSTART:", c.get("dtstart").dt)
            print("DTEND:", c.get("dtend").dt)
            print("STATUS:", c.get("status"))
            print("UID:", c.get("uid"))
    print("VALID ICS")
except ImportError:
    print("icalendar not installed; doing basic check")
    content = open("team_meeting_2026-08-05.ics").read()
    required = ["BEGIN:VCALENDAR", "VERSION:2.0", "PRODID", "BEGIN:VEVENT", "UID", "DTSTAMP", "DTSTART", "DTEND", "SUMMARY", "END:VEVENT", "END:VCALENDAR"]
    missing = [r for r in required if r not in content]
    print("MISSING:", missing if missing else "none - OK")
EOF
